Liger (also known as Liger: Saala Crossbreed) is a 2022 Indian sports action-drama film written and directed by Puri Jagannadh. Shot simultaneously in Hindi and Telugu, it stars Vijay Deverakonda as an MMA fighter with a stammering problem, alongside Ananya Panday, Ramya Krishnan, and a special cameo by boxing legend Mike Tyson

Plot & SynopsisThe story follows Sashwath "Liger" Agarwal (Vijay Deverakonda), an ambitious street fighter from Karimnagar who moves to Mumbai with his intense mother, Balamani (Ramya Krishnan). Balamani is determined to see her son train under elite coach Christopher (Ronit Roy) and become a Mixed Martial Arts (MMA) champion.Liger fights his way through the national ranks, but his absolute focus gets heavily derailed by a rocky, turbulent romance with a wealthy social media influencer named Tanya (Ananya Panday). After continuous domestic conflicts, misunderstandings, and a dramatic kidnapping plot, his journey takes him to the international arena in Las Vegas, where he faces off against his ultimate fighting idol, Mark Anderson (Mike Tyson)

Chakravarthy (Full Movie) Darshan, Deepa Sannidhi | Kannada Film Hindi Dubbed South Action Movie

Chakravarthy (English : Emperor) is a 2017 Indian Kannada-language film directed by Chintan A V, a former screenwriter, making his debut and produced by Kalapi Nagada and Anaji Nagraj is the executive producer. The film features Darshan and Deepa Sannidhi in lead roles besides Kumar Bangarappa, Aditya and Srujan Lokesh playing key supporting roles. The film's score and soundtrack is composed by Arjun Janya whilst the cinematography is by Chandrashekar K S and editing by K. M. Prakash.

Shankar (Darshan) is care free guy having a habit of hunting Tigers in Kodagu. After his father who is a retired army officer sends him to Bengaluru in a search of a job, he decides to wipe out Bengaluru underworld rowdies with the help of Shetty (Kumar Bangarappa) and ACP Suryakanth (Aditya).

Gangster life, from the 1980s to today, is represented in this movie.
